entities.name: Q9X295 phosphoglycerate mutase
observations: Exact sequence match to the reviewed Thermotoga maritima UniProt reference Q9X295; length 401 aa.
Probable 2,3-bisphosphoglycerate-independent phosphoglycerate mutase, EC 5.4.2.12; catalyzes reversible interconversion of 2-phosphoglycerate and 3-phosphoglycerate.
Pfam matches: Metalloenzyme PF01676 (residues 18–390) and PhosphMutase PF10143 (residues 50–218).
Sequence-derived estimates: 44,274.5 Da molecular mass and theoretical pI 6.00.

entities.name: 2-phosphoglycerate to 3-phosphoglycerate
observations: Reversible intramolecular phosphate transfer: (2R)-2-phosphoglycerate = (2R)-3-phosphoglycerate; Rhea RHEA:15901, EC 5.4.2.12.

entities.name: Glycolysis
observations: The reference protein is annotated in glycolysis, catalyzing the phosphoglycerate mutase step in carbohydrate degradation.
